beats: Let the seller speak about his wife without interruption.
Let him consider the museum, dismiss the object as too personal and mention Ellie’s vault.
data.consequences: The necklace leaves the player’s possession and the neighbor’s recovery quest is complete. His gratitude leads to the keepsake and vault visit.

dialogue.context: Existing dialogue. Only after the necklace is returned.

lines.speaker: Seller
lines.text: My wife wore this. Every important day of her life, apparently.

lines.speaker: Seller
lines.text: She's been gone a while. I still put it beside the mirror when I tidy.

description:
Returning the necklace changes a stolen object into a remembered life. The seller works its clasp, mentions important and unimportant days, and folds it into cloth. One pearl catches unusual light; his explanation is ordinary.

The wife’s ownership becomes known here. The pearls’ ecology does not.

sections: Section 10.7: pie, necklace and delayed pearl meaning

name: Return the necklace to the seller
